ns0:problem.ns0:para: Use the graph of the function to find its domain and range. Write the domain and range in interval notation.

ns0:media.alt: This figure has a curved line segment graphed on the x y-coordinate plane. The x-axis runs from negative 4 to 5. The y-axis runs from negative 6 to 4. The curved line segment goes through the points (negative 2, 1), (0, 3), and (4, negative 5). The interval [negative 2, 4] is marked on the horizontal axis. The interval [negative 5, 3] is marked on the vertical axis.

ns0:solution.ns0:para: The domain is [−2,4]. The range is [−5,3].
